name: marketplace-services-status
description: Realtime monitor and control panel for the Marketplace platform's systemd user units

scripts.test:unit: vitest run test/config.test.ts test/monitor.test.ts test/probe.test.ts test/publicApp.test.ts test/publicAppBare.test.ts test/publicAppSecure.test.ts test/server.test.ts test/systemd.test.ts test/systemdGenerate.test.ts
scripts.test:cov: yarn build && vitest run --coverage && node scripts/coverage-audit.mjs
scripts.semgrep: docker run --rm --network none -e HOME=/tmp -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$PWD":/src -w /src semgrep/semgrep:1.172.0 semgrep scan --metrics=off --disable-version-check --config semgrep/ src
scripts.semgrep:ci: docker run --rm --network none -e HOME=/tmp -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$PWD":/src -w /src semgrep/semgrep:1.172.0 semgrep scan --metrics=off --disable-version-check --error --sarif --output semgrep.sarif --config semgrep/ src
scripts.hooks:install: git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks && ./scripts/lockfile-registry-filter.sh install || true
